summary: Longevity Health Holdings (OTCQB: XAGE, formerly Carmell) disclosed an 8-K and press release confirming a Securities Purchase Agreement dated August 31, 2026, with Puritan Partners LLC for up to $694,445 aggregate principal of 10% senior secured convertible notes issued at a 10% OID, yielding up to $625,000 gross proceeds. A first closing on August 31, 2026 produced $375,000 gross via a $416,667 note due February 29, 2028, convertible at $0.50 per share, secured by substantially all assets, funded through two additional notes. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch the below-$1 conversion price, dilution, and Puritan's conversion pace once the additional tranches close.
